title: False payrolls on public work led to two local debarments and a premium-fraud plea

beats.text: A painting contractor agreed to two local debarments.

visual.sub: Two awarding authorities barred the contractor

beats.text: The City and its school district had found false certified payrolls.

visual.kicker: Two awarding authorities barred the contractor

beats.text: Other jurisdictions could still consider bids from the contractor.
State investigators alleged false wage certifications on 23 public projects.

visual.label: Investigators traced payroll certifications on public work

beats.text: The original charges included payroll statements sent to insurers.

visual.kicker: Investigators traced payroll certifications on public work

beats.text: The state register traces the corporation to contractor license 703014.
A search turned up two sets of books.

visual.line: True payroll records and a false set of books

visual.label: Investigators recovered two sets of books

beats.text: State officials made the local complaints visible in the license history.

visual.kicker: Two awarding authorities barred the contractor

beats.text: The prosecutor reported guilty pleas to two premium-fraud violations.

visual.kicker: Investigators recovered two sets of books

beats.text: At sentencing, the contractor paid $20,000 toward restitution.

visual.label: The sentencing report records an actual payment

beats.text: The rest was left to a later hearing.
